output.question: What is fuboTV's short interest?
output.answer: As of the latest reported record date, October 30, 2026, fuboTV (FUBO) had 6,838,404 shares sold short, equal to 23.91% of its public float. MarketBeat reported this was up 0.11% from the prior report, with 6.4 days to cover. Short interest is reported periodically rather than in real time; ShortSqueeze's November 11 quote rounded the figure to 6.84 million shares, but did not provide a separate record date.

key_facts.fact: Short interest represented 23.91% of fuboTV's public float.
The short-interest ratio was 6.4 days to cover, and short interest increased 0.11% from the previous report.
ShortSqueeze displayed 6,840,000 shares short in its November 11, 2026 delayed quote.

passages.quote: As of October 30, 2026, fuboTV (FUBO) had a short interest of 6.84 million shares sold short, representing 23.91% of the public float. This marks a 0.11% increase in short interest since the prior report.

caveats: Short interest is published twice monthly and is not a real-time measure of open short positions.
The November 11 ShortSqueeze quote is delayed and rounded; its page does not identify a distinct short-interest record date, so the October 30 MarketBeat record is the clearest dated figure.
Different vendors may show small differences because of update timing and float calculations.
